name: Jōyō kanji by school grade
attribution: School grades (学年別漢字配当表 2020 and the jōyō table) as recorded in KANJIDIC2 (CC BY-SA 4.0, © EDRDG), https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/KANJIDIC_Project; converted by qinqin
notice: The school grade of each jōyō kanji (Grade 1 to Grade 6, then Secondary for the rest of the 2,136 jōyō kanji) is the one recorded in [KANJIDIC2](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/KANJIDIC_Project) (CC BY-SA 4.0, EDRDG), which follows the 2020 学年別漢字配当表 and the 2010 常用漢字表. Jinmeiyō kanji are not included. Within a level, kanji are ordered by newspaper frequency, then by code point.
